messages:
Alex (Sales): Hey team — handing off Rivermoss. Quick summary: Mid-market, signed 2024-06-01, 12mo term. Dedicated trial in us-west. Renewal check: 2025-10-01 flagged medium risk if infra and enablement not finished. Onboarding ~60% (SSO + dataset ingest failing). Blockers: Okta cert mismatch -> 502s for SSO; ingestion 5xx on batch import. They paused testing yesterday.

Maria (CS): Ack. I will lead onboarding/enablement. Need customer contacts, sample logs, and can we do a live session Wed 09:00 PT? They also want model routing & cost controls walkthrough.

Alex (Sales): Contacts: sam@rivermoss.com (Platform Lead), carla@rivermoss.com (PM). Sam allowed scoped log access. Intro email in 10m. Onboarding doc + sample: https://drive.redwood/rivermoss/onboarding-snapshot

Jon (Eng): Reproduced Okta cert issue: "tls: certificate signed by unknown authority" when calling their IdP. Opening ENG-7892. Patch is config-only; ETA EOD today. Need metadata XML or IdP cert.

Maria (CS): Jon — is this a deploy or config reload? If deploy, we'll plan a maintenance window with customer.

Jon (Eng): Config change requires backend restart on dedicated instance; no code deploy. Will coordinate with infra. For ingestion, need a sanitized CSV and 500 stacktrace from Sam.

Lisa (Support): I'll add a synthetic monitor on the ingest endpoint and create SUPPORT-3421. Alert: page oncall + Jon if 5xx rate >1% over 5m.

Alex (Sales): Intro email sent. Sam replied: uploading IdP metadata + sanitized CSV to shared folder. Maintenance window: Tue 15:00-16:00 PT. Wants 30m pre-call.

Jon (Eng): ENG-7892 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-7892. PR-456 ready. Restart target after Sam confirms window. @infra-bot please queue restart of rivermoss-dedicated-01.

infra-bot: Deployment maintenance request received for rivermoss-dedicated-01. Queue position: 3. Confirm approval and ETA in ENG-7892.

Maria (CS): Owners & next steps:
- Maria (CS): Lead onboarding, schedule enablement Wed 09:00 PT, run feedback capture.
- Jon (Eng): Triage Okta cert (ENG-7892), apply config patch, restart host.
- Lisa (Support): Create monitors, SUPPORT-3421, handle escalations.
- Alex (Sales): Liaison, secure IdP metadata + sample CSV, confirm maintenance window.

Maria (CS): I'll create Jira epic CS-1220 and link ENG-7892 + SUPPORT-3421. Internal sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to confirm restart go/no-go. I'll prep a feedback doc for the enablement session.

Jon (Eng): Need either metadata XML or uploaded cert. If not, we need scoped access to S3 logs. Alex please confirm in the intro email.

Lisa (Support): SUPPORT-3421 logged: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUPPORT-3421. Assigning to myself and Jon for first 48h.

Maria (CS): I'll schedule Tue 14:30 PT 30m pre-call and Wed 09:00 PT enablement. Share feedback doc after the session.

Jon (Eng): Confirmed restart Tue 15:10 PT after pre-call. Will push config change and monitor health. Updates on ENG-7892.

Lisa (Support): Standing by for restart. If 5xx >2% I'll open incident and page oncall.

Alex (Sales): Renewal flag updated in CRM to "monitoring" risk. I'll check adoption metrics in 30 days (tokens/day, embeddings usage). If infra stabilizes + enablement completes risk reduces.

Maria (CS): Thanks team — I'll post CS-1220 link and calendar invites. Use this thread for quick updates. :thumbsup:
